class Reader(string bits)
    position := 0

string alphabet()
    return "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ $%*+-./:"

int character_value(string character)
    characters := alphabet()
    for: i < int(#characters)
        if characters[i] == character
            return i
    return -1

int power2(int exponent)
    value := 1
    for: i < exponent
        value *= 2
    return value

int xor(int first, int second)
    a := first
    b := second
    place := 1
    result := 0
    while a > 0 or b > 0
        if a % 2 != b % 2
            result += place
        a /= 2
        b /= 2
        place *= 2
    return result

string write(int value, int width)
    result := ""
    rest := value
    for: i < width
        result = (if rest % 2 == 0 then "0" else "1") + result
        rest /= 2
    return result

int read(Reader &reader, int width)
    result := 0
    for: i < width
        result = result * 2 + (if reader.bits[reader.position] == "1" then 1 else 0)
        reader.position += 1
    return result

string from_words(int[] words)
    return [for word := words[] then write(word, 8)].join("")

int[] to_words(string bits)
    reader := Reader(bits)
    int[] result := []
    while reader.position + 8 <= int(#bits)
        result = result.append(read(&reader, 8))
    return result

string hexadecimal(int[] words)
    digits := [for word := words[] then word.b16]
    return [for hex := digits[] then "0" * (2 - #hex) + hex].join("")

import math
import bitstream = "./bitstream.qui"
import reed_solomon = "./reed_solomon.qui"
import matrix = "./matrix.qui"
import masking = "./masking.qui"
import render = "./render.qui"

class RequestRecord(string identifier, string level, string mode, string version, string mask, string text)
class BlockSpec(int version, string level, int ec, int b1, int k1, int b2, int k2)
class Tables(BlockSpec[] blocks, int[][] alignment)
class Segment(string mode, string text)
class Split(Segment[] segments, int bits)
class Padding(string bits, int terminator, int zero_fill, int pad_bytes)
class Data(string bits, Padding padding, string[] lines)
class BlockPosition(int block, int position)
class BlockSet(int[][] data, int[][] ec, BlockPosition[] order, int[] sequence)
class Selection(string message, string mode, int version, string level, Split split, BlockSpec block)
class Decoded(bool success, string text, string[] lines)
    ok_blocks := 0
    corrected_blocks := 0
    failed_blocks := 0
    corrected_words := 0
class Image(int[][] cells, int width, int height, int quiet, int scale, bool good)
class Reports()
    string[] codes := []
    string[] codewords := []
    string[] bit_lines := []
    string[] checks := []
    string[] scans := []
    totals := map<string, int>()

string[] input_lines(string path)
    source := file.read(path)
    string[] result := []
    while .source(string &line)
        result = result.append(line)
    return result

void write_lines(string path, string[] lines)
    destination := file.write(path)
    if #lines > 0
        .destination(lines.join(NL) + NL)

int separator(string text, string character)
    for: i < int(#text)
        if text[i] == character
            return i
    return int(#text)

Tables read_tables()
    BlockSpec[] blocks := []
    int[][] alignment := [for i := (int(0):10)[] then []]
    for line := input_lines("input/tables.txt")[]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        version := int(fields[1])
        if fields[0] == "block"
            blocks = blocks.append(BlockSpec(version, fields[2], int(fields[3]), int(fields[4]), int(fields[5]), int(fields[6]), int(fields[7])))
        else
            alignment[version] = [for value := fields[2:][] then int(value)]
    return Tables(blocks, alignment)

BlockSpec lookup_table(Tables tables, int version, string level)
    for block := tables.blocks[]
        if block.version == version and block.level == level
            return block
    return tables.blocks[0]

int data_count(BlockSpec block)
    return block.b1 * block.k1 + block.b2 * block.k2

int total_count(BlockSpec block)
    return data_count(block) + block.ec * (block.b1 + block.b2)

int count_width(string mode, int version)
    if mode == "NUMERIC"
        return if version <= 9 then 10 else 12
    if mode == "ALPHANUMERIC"
        return if version <= 9 then 9 else 11
    return if version <= 9 then 8 else 16

int data_width(string mode, int length)
    if mode == "NUMERIC"
        return 10 * (length / 3) + (if length % 3 == 0 then 0 elif length % 3 == 1 then 4 else 7)
    if mode == "ALPHANUMERIC"
        return 11 * (length / 2) + 6 * (length % 2)
    return 8 * length

bool encodable(string mode, string text)
    for: i < int(#text)
        value := bitstream.character_value(text[i])
        if mode == "NUMERIC" and (value < 0 or value >= 10)
            return false
        if mode == "ALPHANUMERIC" and value < 0
            return false
    return true

Split split_segments(string text, string mode, int version)
    length := int(#text)
    if mode != "MIXED"
        return Split([Segment(mode, text)], 4 + count_width(mode, version) + data_width(mode, length))
    names := ["NUMERIC", "ALPHANUMERIC", "BYTE"]
    bad := [for i := (int(0):<3)[] then array(nat(length + 1), fill = 0)]
    for: k < 3
        for: i < length
            bad[k][i + 1] = bad[k][i] + (if encodable(names[k], text[i]) then 0 else 1)
    int[] costs := [0].concat(array(nat(length), fill = 1000000000))
    starts := array(nat(length + 1), fill = 0)
    chosen := array(nat(length + 1), fill = 0)
    for: 1 <= i <= length
        for: j < i
            for: k < 3
                if bad[k][i] != bad[k][j]
                    continue
                cost := costs[j] + 4 + count_width(names[k], version) + data_width(names[k], i - j)
                if cost < costs[i]
                    costs[i] = cost
                    starts[i] = j
                    chosen[i] = k
    Segment[] segments := []
    cursor := length
    while cursor > 0
        start := starts[cursor]
        segments = [Segment(names[chosen[cursor]], text[start:<cursor])].concat(segments)
        cursor = start
    return Split(segments, costs[length])

Selection select_request(RequestRecord request, Tables tables)
    message := ""
    levels := ["L", "M", "Q", "H", "L+", "M+", "Q+", "H+"]
    modes := ["NUMERIC", "ALPHANUMERIC", "BYTE", "AUTO", "MIXED"]
    level_valid := false
    mode_valid := false
    for level := levels[]
        if request.level == level
            level_valid = true
    for mode := modes[]
        if request.mode == mode
            mode_valid = true
    version_valid := request.version == "AUTO"
    for: 1 <= version <= 10
        if request.version == "{version}"
            version_valid = true
    mask_valid := request.mask == "AUTO"
    for: mask < 8
        if request.mask == "{mask}"
            mask_valid = true
    if not level_valid
        message = "level " + request.level
    elif not mode_valid
        message = "mode " + request.mode
    elif not version_valid
        message = "version " + request.version
    elif not mask_valid
        message = "mask " + request.mask
    elif request.text == ""
        message = "text"
    elif request.mode == "NUMERIC" or request.mode == "ALPHANUMERIC"
        for: i < int(#request.text)
            if not encodable(request.mode, request.text[i])
                message = "charset position {i}"
                break
    empty := tables.blocks[0]
    if message != ""
        return Selection(message, request.mode, 0, "", Split([], 0), empty)
    determined := request.mode
    if determined == "AUTO"
        determined = if encodable("NUMERIC", request.text) then "NUMERIC" elif encodable("ALPHANUMERIC", request.text) then "ALPHANUMERIC" else "BYTE"
    level := request.level[0]
    version := 0
    split := Split([], 0)
    int first := if request.version == "AUTO" then 1 else int(request.version)
    last := if request.version == "AUTO" then 10 else first
    for: first <= candidate <= last
        split = split_segments(request.text, determined, candidate)
        block := lookup_table(tables, candidate, level)
        if split.bits <= 8 * data_count(block)
            version = candidate
            break
    if version == 0
        capacity := 8 * data_count(lookup_table(tables, last, level))
        return Selection("capacity bits {split.bits} capacity {capacity}", determined, 0, level, split, empty)
    if request.level.ends_with("+")
        eligible := false
        for candidate := ["L", "M", "Q", "H"][]
            if candidate == level
                eligible = true
            if eligible and split.bits <= 8 * data_count(lookup_table(tables, version, candidate))
                level = candidate
    return Selection("", determined, version, level, split, lookup_table(tables, version, level))

Padding pad_data(string bits, int capacity)
    terminator := math.min(4, capacity - int(#bits))
    string result := bits + "0" * nat(terminator)
    zero_fill := (8 - int(#result) % 8) % 8
    result += "0" * nat(zero_fill)
    pad_bytes := 0
    while int(#result) < capacity
        result += if pad_bytes % 2 == 0 then "11101100" else "00010001"
        pad_bytes += 1
    return Padding(result, terminator, zero_fill, pad_bytes)

int mode_indicator(string mode)
    return if mode == "NUMERIC" then 1 elif mode == "ALPHANUMERIC" then 2 else 4

Data make_data(Selection selected)
    bits := ""
    string[] lines := []
    for segment := selected.split.segments[]
        indicator := mode_indicator(segment.mode)
        width := count_width(segment.mode, selected.version)
        length := int(#segment.text)
        header := bitstream.write(indicator, 4) + bitstream.write(length, width)
        bits += header
        lines = lines.append("segment {segment.mode} indicator " + bitstream.write(indicator, 4) + " count {length} " + bitstream.write(length, width))
        start := 0
        group_limit := if segment.mode == "NUMERIC" then 3 elif segment.mode == "ALPHANUMERIC" then 2 else 1
        while start < length
            size := math.min(group_limit, length - start)
            part := segment.text[start:<start + size]
            value := 0
            group_width := 8
            if segment.mode == "NUMERIC"
                for: i < size
                    value = value * 10 + bitstream.character_value(part[i])
                group_width = if size == 3 then 10 elif size == 2 then 7 else 4
            elif segment.mode == "ALPHANUMERIC"
                value = bitstream.character_value(part[0])
                if size == 2
                    value = value * 45 + bitstream.character_value(part[1])
                group_width = if size == 2 then 11 else 6
            else
                value = part.codepoints()[0]
            group := bitstream.write(value, group_width)
            bits += group
            lines = lines.append("group {value} {group} " + DQ + part + DQ)
            start += size
    padded := pad_data(bits, 8 * data_count(selected.block))
    lines = lines.append("terminator {padded.terminator} zero_fill {padded.zero_fill} pad_bytes {padded.pad_bytes}")
    return Data(bits, padded, lines)

BlockPosition[] placement(BlockSpec spec)
    count := spec.b1 + spec.b2
    BlockPosition[] order := []
    maximum := math.max(spec.k1, spec.k2)
    for: i < maximum
        for: block < count
            size := if block < spec.b1 then spec.k1 else spec.k2
            if i < size
                order = order.append(BlockPosition(block, i))
    for: i < spec.ec
        for: block < count
            size := if block < spec.b1 then spec.k1 else spec.k2
            order = order.append(BlockPosition(block, size + i))
    return order

BlockSet make_blocks(reed_solomon.Field field, BlockSpec spec, int[] words)
    int[][] data := []
    int[][] ec := []
    start := 0
    for: block < spec.b1 + spec.b2
        size := if block < spec.b1 then spec.k1 else spec.k2
        part := words[start:<start + size]
        data = data.append(part)
        ec = ec.append(reed_solomon.encode(field, part, spec.ec))
        start += size
    order := placement(spec)
    int[] sequence := []
    for position := order[]
        size := int(#data[position.block])
        sequence = sequence.append(if position.position < size then data[position.block][position.position] else ec[position.block][position.position - size])
    return BlockSet(data, ec, order, sequence)

int[][] transpose(int[][] cells)
    size := int(#cells)
    return [for y := (0:<size)[] then [for x := (0:<size)[] then cells[x][y]]]

int[][] rotate(int[][] cells)
    size := int(#cells)
    return [for y := (0:<size)[] then [for x := (0:<size)[] then cells[size - 1 - x][y]]]

int hamming(int a, int b)
    differing := bitstream.xor(a, b)
    count := 0
    while differing > 0
        count += differing % 2
        differing /= 2
    return count

string ascii_character(int code)
    string characters := " !" + DQ + "#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{{|}}~"
    return characters[code - 32]

Decoded decode_attempt(int[][] cells, Tables tables, reed_solomon.Field field)
    size := int(#cells)
    version := (size - 17) / 4
    result := Decoded(false, "", [])
    first_format := matrix.read_value(cells, matrix.format_positions(size, false))
    second_format := matrix.read_value(cells, matrix.format_positions(size, true))
    distances := [16, 16]
    levels := ["", ""]
    masks := [0, 0]
    for: copy < 2
        value := if copy == 0 then first_format else second_format
        for level := ["L", "M", "Q", "H"][]
            for: mask < 8
                distance := hamming(value, matrix.format_value(level, mask))
                if distance < distances[copy]
                    distances[copy] = distance
                    levels[copy] = level
                    masks[copy] = mask
    chosen := if distances[1] < distances[0] then 1 else 0
    format_line := "format " + bitstream.write(first_format, 15) + " " + bitstream.write(second_format, 15) + " distance {distances[0]} {distances[1]}"
    if distances[chosen] > 3
        result.lines = [format_line + " unreadable"]
        return result
    level := levels[chosen]
    mask := masks[chosen]
    result.lines = [format_line + " level {level} mask {mask}"]
    if version >= 7
        first_version := matrix.read_value(cells, matrix.version_positions(size, false))
        second_version := matrix.read_value(cells, matrix.version_positions(size, true))
        version_distances := [19, 19]
        versions := [0, 0]
        for: copy < 2
            value := if copy == 0 then first_version else second_version
            for: 7 <= candidate <= 40
                distance := hamming(value, matrix.version_value(candidate))
                if distance < version_distances[copy]
                    version_distances[copy] = distance
                    versions[copy] = candidate
        copy := if version_distances[1] < version_distances[0] then 1 else 0
        line := "version " + bitstream.write(first_version, 18) + " " + bitstream.write(second_version, 18) + " distance {version_distances[0]} {version_distances[1]}"
        if version_distances[copy] > 3
            result.lines = result.lines.append(line + " unreadable")
            return result
        result.lines = result.lines.append(line + " decoded {versions[copy]}")
        if versions[copy] != version
            return result
    spec := lookup_table(tables, version, level)
    pattern := matrix.make(version, tables.alignment[version])
    unmasked := masking.apply(cells, pattern.areas, mask)
    matrix.Point[] order := matrix.reading_order(pattern)
    bits := [for point := order[] then (if unmasked[point.y][point.x] == 1 then "1" else "0")].join("")
    sequence := bitstream.to_words(bits[0:<8 * total_count(spec)])
    received := [for block := (0:<(spec.b1 + spec.b2))[] then array(nat((if block < spec.b1 then spec.k1 else spec.k2) + spec.ec), fill = 0)]
    interleave := placement(spec)
    for: i < int(#sequence)
        received[interleave[i].block][interleave[i].position] = sequence[i]
    int[] data := []
    for: block < spec.b1 + spec.b2
        corrected := reed_solomon.correct(field, received[block], spec.ec)
        line := "block {block} syndromes " + bitstream.hexadecimal(corrected.syndromes)
        if not corrected.success
            line += " failed"
            result.failed_blocks += 1
        elif #corrected.positions == 0
            line += " ok"
            result.ok_blocks += 1
        else
            line += " corrected " + [for position := corrected.positions[] then "{position}"].join(" ")
            result.corrected_blocks += 1
            result.corrected_words += int(#corrected.positions)
        result.lines = result.lines.append(line)
        length := if block < spec.b1 then spec.k1 else spec.k2
        data = data.concat(corrected.words[0:<length])
    if result.failed_blocks > 0
        return result
    bits = bitstream.from_words(data)
    reader := bitstream.Reader(bits)
    end := 0
    text := ""
    while int(#bits) - reader.position >= 4
        indicator := bitstream.read(&reader, 4)
        if indicator == 0
            break
        mode := if indicator == 1 then "NUMERIC" elif indicator == 2 then "ALPHANUMERIC" elif indicator == 4 then "BYTE" else ""
        if mode == ""
            result.lines = result.lines.append("parse failed indicator " + bitstream.write(indicator, 4))
            return result
        width := count_width(mode, version)
        if int(#bits) - reader.position < width
            result.lines = result.lines.append("parse failed length " + mode)
            return result
        length := bitstream.read(&reader, width)
        if int(#bits) - reader.position < data_width(mode, length)
            result.lines = result.lines.append("parse failed length " + mode)
            return result
        remaining := length
        group_limit := if mode == "NUMERIC" then 3 elif mode == "ALPHANUMERIC" then 2 else 1
        while remaining > 0
            group_size := math.min(group_limit, remaining)
            group_width := if mode == "NUMERIC" then (if group_size == 3 then 10 elif group_size == 2 then 7 else 4) elif mode == "ALPHANUMERIC" then (if group_size == 2 then 11 else 6) else 8
            value := bitstream.read(&reader, group_width)
            valid := true
            if mode == "NUMERIC"
                limit := if group_size == 3 then 1000 elif group_size == 2 then 100 else 10
                valid = value < limit
                if valid
                    part := "{value}"
                    text += "0" * nat(group_size - int(#part)) + part
            elif mode == "ALPHANUMERIC"
                valid = value < (if group_size == 2 then 2025 else 45)
                if valid
                    alphabet := bitstream.alphabet()
                    text += if group_size == 2 then alphabet[value / 45] + alphabet[value % 45] else alphabet[value]
            else
                valid = 32 <= value and value <= 126
                if valid
                    text += ascii_character(value)
            if not valid
                result.lines = result.lines.append("parse failed value " + mode)
                return result
            remaining -= group_size
        end = reader.position
        result.lines = result.lines.append("segment {mode} {length}")
    good := pad_data(bits[0:<end], int(#bits)).bits == bits
    result.lines = result.lines.append(if good then "padding ok" else "padding bad")
    result.lines = result.lines.append("text " + DQ + text + DQ)
    result.text = text
    result.success = true
    return result

Decoded decode(int[][] cells, Tables tables, reed_solomon.Field field)
    size := int(#cells)
    corners := [matrix.Point(size - 7, size - 7), matrix.Point(size - 7, 0), matrix.Point(0, 0), matrix.Point(0, size - 7)]
    rotations := 0
    minimum := 50
    for: k < 4
        score := 0
        for: y < 7
            for: x < 7
                expected := if math.max(math.abs(x - 3), math.abs(y - 3)) == 2 then 0 else 1
                if cells[corners[k].y + y][corners[k].x + x] == expected
                    score += 1
        if score < minimum
            minimum = score
            rotations = k
    oriented := cells
    for: i < rotations
        oriented = rotate(oriented)
    adopted := decode_attempt(oriented, tables, field)
    mirrored := false
    if not adopted.success
        alternative := decode_attempt(transpose(oriented), tables, field)
        if alternative.success
            adopted = alternative
            mirrored = true
    mirror := if mirrored then "yes" else "no"
    adopted.lines = ["orientation rotations {rotations} mirrored {mirror}"].concat(adopted.lines)
    return adopted

Image read_image(string[] lines)
    dimensions := lines[1].split(" ")
    width := int(dimensions[0])
    height := int(dimensions[1])
    left := width
    right := -1
    top := height
    for: y < height
        for: x < width
            if lines[y + 2][x] == "1"
                left = math.min(left, x)
                right = math.max(right, x)
                top = math.min(top, y)
    run := 0
    while left + run < width and lines[top + 2][left + run] == "1"
        run += 1
    unit := run / 7
    size := (right - left + 1) / unit
    cells := [for y := (0:<size)[] then [for x := (0:<size)[] then (if lines[top + unit * y + 2][left + unit * x] == "1" then 1 else 0)]]
    good := true
    for: y < height
        for: x < width
            expected := 0
            if left <= x and x < left + unit * size and top <= y and y < top + unit * size
                expected = cells[(y - top) / unit][(x - left) / unit]
            if (lines[y + 2][x] == "1") != (expected == 1)
                good = false
    return Image(cells, width, height, left / unit, unit, good)

string check_result(Decoded decoded, string expected)
    return if not decoded.success then "failed" elif decoded.text == expected then "ok" else "mismatch"

void record_check(Reports &reports, Decoded decoded, string expected)
    .reports.totals.increment("checks")
    .reports.totals.increment("checks." + check_result(decoded, expected))
    .reports.totals.increment("blocks.ok", by = decoded.ok_blocks)
    .reports.totals.increment("blocks.corrected", by = decoded.corrected_blocks)
    .reports.totals.increment("blocks.failed", by = decoded.failed_blocks)
    .reports.totals.increment("blocks.codewords", by = decoded.corrected_words)

int tolerance(int[][] cells, int color, string expected, Tables tables, reed_solomon.Field field)
    size := int(#cells)
    for: 1 <= square <= size
        first := (size - square) / 2
        damaged := cells
        for: first <= y < first + square
            for: first <= x < first + square
                damaged[y][x] = color
        result := decode(damaged, tables, field)
        if not result.success or result.text != expected
            return square - 1
    return size

void selfcheck(Reports &reports, RequestRecord request, Selection selected, int[][] cells, matrix.Pattern pattern, BlockSet blocks, Tables tables, reed_solomon.Field field, string[][] operations)
    image := read_image(input_lines("output/qr_{request.identifier}.pbm"))
    verdict := if image.good then "ok" else "bad"
    lines := ["request {request.identifier}", "image {image.width} {image.height} quiet {image.quiet} scale {image.scale} size {#image.cells} {verdict}", "check clean"]
    clean := decode(image.cells, tables, field)
    lines = lines.concat(clean.lines).append("result " + check_result(clean, request.text))
    record_check(&reports, clean, request.text)
    if #operations > 0
        size := int(#cells)
        damaged := cells
        for operation := operations[]
            if operation[1] == "flip"
                x := int(operation[2])
                y := int(operation[3])
                damaged[y][x] = 1 - damaged[y][x]
            elif operation[1] == "fill"
                first_x := int(operation[2])
                first_y := int(operation[3])
                width := int(operation[4])
                height := int(operation[5])
                color := if operation[6] == "dark" then 1 else 0
                for: first_y <= y < first_y + height
                    for: first_x <= x < first_x + width
                        damaged[y][x] = color
        matrix.Point[] order := matrix.reading_order(pattern)
        positions := [for y := (0:<size)[] then array(nat(size), fill = -1)]
        for: i < int(#order)
            positions[order[i].y][order[i].x] = i
        changed := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        damaged_words := [for block := (0:<(selected.block.b1 + selected.block.b2))[] then distinct<int>()]
        for: y < size
            for: x < size
                if cells[y][x] == damaged[y][x]
                    continue
                area := pattern.areas[y][x]
                category := if area == 1 then 0 elif area == 2 then 1 elif area == 3 then 2 elif positions[y][x] < int(#blocks.sequence) * 8 then 3 else 4
                changed[category] += 1
                if category == 3
                    position := blocks.order[positions[y][x] / 8]
                    .damaged_words[position.block].add(position.position)
        total := 0
        for value := changed[]
            total += value
        lines = lines.append("check damaged operations {#operations}")
        lines = lines.append("damage changed {total} function {changed[0]} format {changed[1]} version {changed[2]} data {changed[3]} remainder {changed[4]}")
        errors := [for words := damaged_words[] then "{words.size()}"].join(" ")
        lines = lines.append("errors {errors} limit {selected.block.ec / 2}")
        for operation := operations[]
            if operation[1] == "rotate"
                damaged = rotate(damaged)
            elif operation[1] == "mirror"
                damaged = transpose(damaged)
        checked := decode(damaged, tables, field)
        lines = lines.concat(checked.lines).append("result " + check_result(checked, request.text))
        record_check(&reports, checked, request.text)
    light := tolerance(cells, 0, request.text, tables, field)
    dark := tolerance(cells, 1, request.text, tables, field)
    reports.checks = reports.checks.concat(lines).append("tolerance light {light} dark {dark}")

int dark_count(int[][] cells)
    count := 0
    for row := cells[]
        for value := row[]
            count += value
    return count

void encode_request(Reports &reports, RequestRecord request, Tables tables, reed_solomon.Field field, int quiet, int scale, string[][] operations)
    .reports.totals.increment("requests")
    reports.codes = reports.codes.append("request {request.identifier}")
    selected := select_request(request, tables)
    if selected.message != ""
        reports.codes = reports.codes.append("error " + selected.message)
        .reports.totals.increment("errors")
        .reports.totals.increment("error." + selected.message.split(" ")[0])
        return
    .reports.totals.increment("encoded")
    .reports.totals.increment("mode." + selected.mode)
    .reports.totals.increment("level." + selected.level)
    .reports.totals.increment("version.{selected.version}")
    if selected.level != request.level[0]
        .reports.totals.increment("boosted")
    data := make_data(selected)
    blocks := make_blocks(field, selected.block, bitstream.to_words(data.padding.bits))
    pattern := matrix.make(selected.version, tables.alignment[selected.version])
    matrix.Point[] order := matrix.reading_order(pattern)
    placed_bits := bitstream.from_words(blocks.sequence)
    unmasked := pattern.cells
    for: i < int(#order)
        point := order[i]
        unmasked[point.y][point.x] = if i < int(#placed_bits) and placed_bits[i] == "1" then 1 else 0
    int[][][] symbols := []
    masking.Penalty[] penalties := []
    chosen := 0
    for: mask < 8
        symbol := masking.apply(unmasked, pattern.areas, mask)
        for second := [false, true][]
            matrix.write_value(&symbol, matrix.format_positions(pattern.size, second), matrix.format_value(selected.level, mask))
        symbols = symbols.append(symbol)
        penalties = penalties.append(masking.penalty(symbol))
        if masking.total(penalties[mask]) < masking.total(penalties[chosen])
            chosen = mask
    if request.mask != "AUTO"
        chosen = int(request.mask)
    cells := symbols[chosen]
    dark := dark_count(cells)
    capacity := 8 * data_count(selected.block)
    reports.codes = reports.codes.append("symbol version {selected.version} level {selected.level} mask {chosen} size {pattern.size}")
    segments := [for segment := selected.split.segments[] then "{segment.mode}:{#segment.text}"].join(" ")
    reports.codes = reports.codes.append("segments {#selected.split.segments} {segments}")
    string[] alternatives := []
    for mode := ["NUMERIC", "ALPHANUMERIC", "BYTE"][]
        amount := if encodable(mode, request.text) then "{split_segments(request.text, mode, selected.version).bits}" else "-"
        alternatives = alternatives.append("{mode} {amount}")
    alternatives = alternatives.append("MIXED {split_segments(request.text, "MIXED", selected.version).bits}")
    reports.codes = reports.codes.append("bits data {selected.split.bits} capacity {capacity} alternatives " + alternatives.join(" "))
    string[] fits := []
    for level := ["L", "M", "Q", "H"][]
        fitting := "-"
        for: 1 <= version <= 10
            if split_segments(request.text, selected.mode, version).bits <= 8 * data_count(lookup_table(tables, version, level))
                fitting = "{version}"
                break
        fits = fits.append("{level} {fitting}")
    reports.codes = reports.codes.append("fits " + fits.join(" "))
    reports.codes = reports.codes.append("modules function {pattern.size * pattern.size - int(#order)} data {#order} remainder {int(#order) - int(#placed_bits)} dark {dark}")
    version_bits := if selected.version >= 7 then bitstream.write(matrix.version_value(selected.version), 18) else "none"
    reports.codes = reports.codes.append("format " + bitstream.write(matrix.format_value(selected.level, chosen), 15) + " version " + version_bits)
    for: mask < 8
        penalty := penalties[mask]
        reports.codes = reports.codes.append("penalty {mask} n1 {penalty.n1} n2 {penalty.n2} n3 {penalty.n3} n4 {penalty.n4} total {masking.total(penalty)}")
    reports.codes = reports.codes.concat(render.symbol(cells))
    reports.codewords = reports.codewords.append("request {request.identifier} version {selected.version} level {selected.level} blocks {#blocks.data} data {data_count(selected.block)} ec_per_block {selected.block.ec} total {#blocks.sequence}")
    for: block < int(#blocks.data)
        reports.codewords = reports.codewords.append("block {block} data " + bitstream.hexadecimal(blocks.data[block]))
        reports.codewords = reports.codewords.append("block {block} ec " + bitstream.hexadecimal(blocks.ec[block]))
    reports.codewords = reports.codewords.append("interleaved " + bitstream.hexadecimal(blocks.sequence))
    reports.bit_lines = reports.bit_lines.append("request {request.identifier} version {selected.version} bits {selected.split.bits} capacity {capacity}").concat(data.lines)
    write_lines("output/qr_{request.identifier}.pbm", render.pbm(cells, quiet, scale))
    selfcheck(&reports, request, selected, cells, pattern, blocks, tables, field, operations)
    .reports.totals.increment("mask.{chosen}")
    .reports.totals.increment("segments", by = int(#selected.split.segments))
    .reports.totals.increment("data_codewords", by = data_count(selected.block))
    .reports.totals.increment("ec_codewords", by = selected.block.ec * (selected.block.b1 + selected.block.b2))
    .reports.totals.increment("modules", by = pattern.size * pattern.size)
    .reports.totals.increment("dark", by = dark)

string[] capacity_report(Tables tables)
    string[] lines := []
    for: 1 <= version <= 10
        pattern := matrix.make(version, tables.alignment[version])
        modules := int(#matrix.reading_order(pattern))
        words := total_count(lookup_table(tables, version, "L"))
        alignment := if #tables.alignment[version] == 0 then "none" else [for value := tables.alignment[version][] then "{value}"].join(" ")
        lines = lines.append("version {version} size {pattern.size} data_modules {modules} codewords {words} remainder {modules - 8 * words} alignment {alignment}")
        for level := ["L", "M", "Q", "H"][]
            block := lookup_table(tables, version, level)
            int[] capacities := []
            for mode := ["NUMERIC", "ALPHANUMERIC", "BYTE"][]
                length := 0
                while 4 + count_width(mode, version) + data_width(mode, length + 1) <= 8 * data_count(block)
                    length += 1
                capacities = capacities.append(length)
            lines = lines.append("level {level} blocks {block.b1 + block.b2} data {data_count(block)} ec_per_block {block.ec} numeric {capacities[0]} alphanumeric {capacities[1]} byte {capacities[2]}")
    return lines

int total_value(Reports reports, string key)
    match reports.totals.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

string total_fields(Reports reports, string prefix, string[] names)
    return [for name := names[] then "{name} {total_value(reports, prefix + name)}"].join(" ")

string[] summary(Reports reports)
    return [
        "requests {total_value(reports, "requests")} encoded {total_value(reports, "encoded")} errors {total_value(reports, "errors")}",
        "error_kinds " + total_fields(reports, "error.", ["level", "mode", "version", "mask", "text", "charset", "capacity"]),
        "modes " + total_fields(reports, "mode.", ["NUMERIC", "ALPHANUMERIC", "BYTE", "MIXED"]),
        "levels " + total_fields(reports, "level.", ["L", "M", "Q", "H"]) + " boosted {total_value(reports, "boosted")}",
        "versions " + [for version := (int(1):10)[] then "{total_value(reports, "version.{version}")}"].join(" "),
        "masks " + [for mask := (int(0):<8)[] then "{total_value(reports, "mask.{mask}")}"].join(" "),
        total_fields(reports, "", ["segments", "data_codewords", "ec_codewords"]),
        total_fields(reports, "", ["modules", "dark"]),
        "checks {total_value(reports, "checks")} " + total_fields(reports, "checks.", ["ok", "mismatch", "failed"]),
        "blocks " + total_fields(reports, "blocks.", ["ok", "corrected", "failed", "codewords"]),
        "scans {total_value(reports, "scans")} " + total_fields(reports, "scans.", ["decoded", "failed"])
    ]

void external_scans(Reports &reports, Tables tables, reed_solomon.Field field)
    lines := input_lines("input/scans.txt")
    position := 0
    while position < int(#lines)
        name := lines[position].split(" ")[1]
        position += 1
        size := int(#lines[position])
        cells := [for y := (0:<size)[] then [for x := (0:<size)[] then (if lines[position + y][x] == "#" then 1 else 0)]]
        position += size
        decoded := decode(cells, tables, field)
        status := if decoded.success then "decoded" else "failed"
        reports.scans = reports.scans.append("scan {name} size {size}").concat(decoded.lines).append("result " + status)
        .reports.totals.increment("scans")
        .reports.totals.increment("scans." + status)

void run_program()
    if not file.exists("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    tables := read_tables()
    field := reed_solomon.Field()
    parameters := input_lines("input/params.txt")
    quiet := int(parameters[0].split(" ")[1])
    scale := int(parameters[1].split(" ")[1])
    damage := [for line := input_lines("input/damage.txt")[] then line.split(" ")]
    reports := Reports()
    for line := input_lines("input/requests.txt")[]
        colon := separator(line, ":")
        header := line[0:<colon].split(" ")
        request := RequestRecord(header[0], header[1], header[2], header[3], header[4], line[colon + 1:])
        operations := [for operation := damage[] if operation[0] == request.identifier then operation]
        encode_request(&reports, request, tables, field, quiet, scale, operations)
    external_scans(&reports, tables, field)
    write_lines("output/codes.txt", reports.codes)
    write_lines("output/codewords.txt", reports.codewords)
    write_lines("output/bitstream.txt", reports.bit_lines)
    write_lines("output/selfcheck.txt", reports.checks)
    write_lines("output/scans.txt", reports.scans)
    write_lines("output/capacity.txt", capacity_report(tables))
    write_lines("output/summary.txt", summary(reports))

run_program()

import math

class Penalty(int n1, int n2, int n3, int n4)

int total(Penalty penalty)
    return penalty.n1 + penalty.n2 + penalty.n3 + penalty.n4

bool condition(int mask, int x, int y)
    if mask == 0
        return (x + y) % 2 == 0
    if mask == 1
        return y % 2 == 0
    if mask == 2
        return x % 3 == 0
    if mask == 3
        return (x + y) % 3 == 0
    if mask == 4
        return (y / 2 + x / 3) % 2 == 0
    if mask == 5
        return (x * y) % 2 + (x * y) % 3 == 0
    if mask == 6
        return ((x * y) % 2 + (x * y) % 3) % 2 == 0
    return ((x + y) % 2 + (x * y) % 3) % 2 == 0

int[][] apply(int[][] cells, int[][] areas, int mask)
    result := cells
    for: y < int(#cells)
        for: x < int(#cells)
            if areas[y][x] == 0 and condition(mask, x, y)
                result[y][x] = 1 - result[y][x]
    return result

Penalty penalty(int[][] cells)
    size := int(#cells)
    n1 := 0
    n2 := 0
    n3 := 0
    dark := 0
    for: y < size
        for: x < size
            dark += cells[y][x]
            if x + 1 < size and y + 1 < size and cells[y][x] == cells[y + 1][x] and cells[y][x] == cells[y][x + 1] and cells[y][x] == cells[y + 1][x + 1]
                n2 += 3
    for vertical := [false, true][]
        for: line < size
            bits := ""
            previous := -1
            run := 0
            for: position < size
                value := if vertical then cells[position][line] else cells[line][position]
                bits += if value == 0 then "0" else "1"
                if value == previous
                    run += 1
                else
                    if run >= 5
                        n1 += run - 2
                    run = 1
                    previous = value
            if run >= 5
                n1 += run - 2
            for: start <= size - 11
                window := bits[start:<start + 11]
                if window == "10111010000" or window == "00001011101"
                    n3 += 40
    n4 := 10 * (math.abs(20 * dark - 10 * size * size) / (size * size))
    return Penalty(n1, n2, n3, n4)

import math
import bitstream = "./bitstream.qui"

class Point(int x, int y)
class Pattern(int version)
    size := 17 + 4 * version
    int[][] cells := [for y := (0:<size)[] then array(nat(size), fill = 0)]
    int[][] areas := [for y := (0:<size)[] then array(nat(size), fill = 0)]

Point[] format_positions(int size, bool second)
    Point[] positions := []
    for: i < 15
        point := Point(0, 0)
        if second
            point = if i < 8 then Point(size - 1 - i, 8) else Point(8, size - 15 + i)
        else
            point = if i < 6 then Point(8, i) elif i == 6 then Point(8, 7) elif i == 7 then Point(8, 8) elif i == 8 then Point(7, 8) else Point(14 - i, 8)
        positions = positions.append(point)
    return positions

Point[] version_positions(int size, bool second)
    return [for i := (int(0):<18)[] then (if second then Point(i / 3, size - 11 + i % 3) else Point(size - 11 + i % 3, i / 3))]

int degree(int value)
    result := -1
    rest := value
    while rest > 0
        result += 1
        rest /= 2
    return result

int remainder(int value, int divisor)
    result := value
    highest := degree(divisor)
    while degree(result) >= highest
        result = bitstream.xor(result, divisor * bitstream.power2(degree(result) - highest))
    return result

int format_value(string level, int mask)
    indicator := if level == "L" then 1 elif level == "M" then 0 elif level == "Q" then 3 else 2
    value := (8 * indicator + mask) * 1024
    return bitstream.xor(value + remainder(value, 1335), 21522)

int version_value(int version)
    value := version * 4096
    return value + remainder(value, 7973)

void write_value(int[][] &cells, Point[] positions, int value)
    rest := value
    for point := positions[]
        cells[point.y][point.x] = rest % 2
        rest /= 2

int read_value(int[][] cells, Point[] positions)
    result := 0
    place := 1
    for point := positions[]
        result += cells[point.y][point.x] * place
        place *= 2
    return result

void set_module(Pattern &pattern, int x, int y, int value, area := 1)
    if 0 <= x and x < pattern.size and 0 <= y and y < pattern.size
        pattern.cells[y][x] = value
        pattern.areas[y][x] = area

Pattern make(int version, int[] alignment)
    pattern := Pattern(version)
    size := pattern.size
    for center := [Point(3, 3), Point(size - 4, 3), Point(3, size - 4)][]
        for: -4 <= dy <= 4
            for: -4 <= dx <= 4
                distance := math.max(math.abs(dx), math.abs(dy))
                set_module(&pattern, center.x + dx, center.y + dy, if distance == 0 or distance == 1 or distance == 3 then 1 else 0)
    for: 8 <= i <= size - 9
        set_module(&pattern, 6, i, if i % 2 == 0 then 1 else 0)
        set_module(&pattern, i, 6, if i % 2 == 0 then 1 else 0)
    for cy := alignment[]
        for cx := alignment[]
            first := alignment[0]
            last := alignment[-1]
            if (cx == first and cy == first) or (cx == first and cy == last) or (cx == last and cy == first)
                continue
            for: -2 <= dy <= 2
                for: -2 <= dx <= 2
                    distance := math.max(math.abs(dx), math.abs(dy))
                    set_module(&pattern, cx + dx, cy + dy, if distance == 1 then 0 else 1)
    set_module(&pattern, 8, size - 8, 1)
    for second := [false, true][]
        for point := format_positions(size, second)[]
            set_module(&pattern, point.x, point.y, 0, 2)
        if version >= 7
            positions := version_positions(size, second)
            for point := positions[]
                set_module(&pattern, point.x, point.y, 0, 3)
            write_value(&pattern.cells, positions, version_value(version))
    return pattern

Point[] reading_order(Pattern pattern)
    Point[] positions := []
    right := pattern.size - 1
    pair := 0
    while right >= 1
        if right == 6
            right = 5
        for: offset < pattern.size
            y := if pair % 2 == 0 then pattern.size - 1 - offset else offset
            for: column < 2
                x := right - column
                if pattern.areas[y][x] == 0
                    positions = positions.append(Point(x, y))
        pair += 1
        right -= 2
    return positions

import bitstream = "./bitstream.qui"

class Field()
    powers := array(nat(255), fill = 0)
    logs := array(nat(256), fill = 0)
    local value := 1
    for: i < 255
        powers[i] = value
        logs[value] = i
        value *= 2
        if value >= 256
            value = bitstream.xor(value, 285)
class Correction(int[] words, int[] syndromes, int[] positions, bool success)

int multiply(Field field, int a, int b)
    return if a == 0 or b == 0 then 0 else field.powers[(field.logs[a] + field.logs[b]) % 255]

int divide(Field field, int a, int b)
    return if a == 0 then 0 else field.powers[(field.logs[a] - field.logs[b] + 255) % 255]

int[] generator(Field field, int degree)
    coefficients := [1]
    for: i < degree
        next := array(nat(int(#coefficients) + 1), fill = 0)
        for: j < int(#coefficients)
            next[j] = bitstream.xor(next[j], coefficients[j])
            next[j + 1] = bitstream.xor(next[j + 1], multiply(field, coefficients[j], field.powers[i]))
        coefficients = next
    return coefficients

int[] encode(Field field, int[] data, int degree)
    polynomial := generator(field, degree)
    int[] work := data.concat(array(nat(degree), fill = 0))
    for: i < int(#data)
        factor := work[i]
        for: j <= degree
            work[i + j] = bitstream.xor(work[i + j], multiply(field, factor, polynomial[j]))
    return work[int(#data):]

int[] syndromes(Field field, int[] received, int degree)
    int[] result := []
    for: j < degree
        sum := 0
        for word := received[]
            sum = bitstream.xor(multiply(field, sum, field.powers[j]), word)
        result = result.append(sum)
    return result

bool all_zero(int[] values)
    for value := values[]
        if value != 0
            return false
    return true

int evaluate(Field field, int[] polynomial, int value)
    result := 0
    index := int(#polynomial) - 1
    while index >= 0
        result = bitstream.xor(multiply(field, result, value), polynomial[index])
        index -= 1
    return result

Correction correct(Field field, int[] received, int degree)
    sums := syndromes(field, received, degree)
    if all_zero(sums)
        return Correction(received, sums, [], true)
    int[] locator := [1].concat(array(nat(degree), fill = 0))
    previous := locator
    length := 0
    shift := 1
    beta := 1
    for: q < degree
        delta := sums[q]
        for: 1 <= i <= length
            delta = bitstream.xor(delta, multiply(field, locator[i], sums[q - i]))
        if delta == 0
            shift += 1
            continue
        original := locator
        factor := divide(field, delta, beta)
        for: i <= degree - shift
            locator[i + shift] = bitstream.xor(locator[i + shift], multiply(field, factor, previous[i]))
        if 2 * length <= q
            length = q + 1 - length
            previous = original
            beta = delta
            shift = 1
        else
            shift += 1
    if length > degree / 2
        return Correction(received, sums, [], false)
    size := int(#received)
    int[] positions := []
    for: i < size
        int inverse := field.powers[(255 - (size - 1 - i)) % 255]
        if evaluate(field, locator, inverse) == 0
            positions = positions.append(i)
    if int(#positions) != length
        return Correction(received, sums, [], false)
    omega := array(nat(degree), fill = 0)
    for: i < degree
        for: j <= degree
            if i + j < degree
                omega[i + j] = bitstream.xor(omega[i + j], multiply(field, sums[i], locator[j]))
    derivative := array(nat(degree), fill = 0)
    for: 1 <= i <= degree
        if i % 2 == 1
            derivative[i - 1] = locator[i]
    corrected := received
    for i := positions[]
        int x := field.powers[(size - 1 - i) % 255]
        int inverse := field.powers[(255 - (size - 1 - i)) % 255]
        denominator := evaluate(field, derivative, inverse)
        if denominator == 0
            return Correction(received, sums, [], false)
        amount := divide(field, multiply(field, x, evaluate(field, omega, inverse)), denominator)
        corrected[i] = bitstream.xor(corrected[i], amount)
    if not all_zero(syndromes(field, corrected, degree))
        return Correction(received, sums, [], false)
    return Correction(corrected, sums, positions, true)

string[] symbol(int[][] cells)
    return [for row := cells[] then [for value := row[] then (if value == 1 then "#" else ".")].join("")]

string[] pbm(int[][] cells, int quiet, int scale)
    size := int(#cells)
    width := (size + 2 * quiet) * scale
    lines := ["P1", "{width} {width}"]
    for: py < width
        row := ""
        y := py / scale - quiet
        for: px < width
            x := px / scale - quiet
            dark := x >= 0 and y >= 0 and x < size and y < size and cells[y][x] == 1
            row += if dark then "1" else "0"
        lines = lines.append(row)
    return lines
